purpose: Custom HUD status decals, four generated frames per effect

prompts.hydro:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production animated first-person shooter HUD status decal, a four-frame sprite flipbook sheet.
Create ONE square transparent PNG spritesheet, EXACTLY a 2 by 2 equal grid. Each of the four equal square cells contains a complete rectangular border vignette for the SAME status. Frame order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. No gutters, no outlines between cells, no labels or text.
Each cell: organic detailed material creeping inward ONLY from its four OUTER edges. Occupy the outermost 10 percent, taper to complete transparency by 14 percent of each side. The central 72 percent by 72 percent is entirely transparent and empty. Strong asymmetric corner clusters and varied interrupted strips along the edges, with transparent breaks. Make it a real continuous environmental contamination of the player's peripheral vision, not a string of repeated icons.
Animation: four clearly distinct successive frames of a gentle looping evolution. Preserve the edge footprint and status identity; shift the tiny material details, flow direction and tips naturally. No flashing the whole border on/off. All four cells have the same scale and border thickness.
Style: richly textured painted game VFX, crisp high contrast edges and soft wispy falloff, readable at low resolution, restrained retro sci-fi FPS aesthetic, polished bespoke materials. Genuinely transparent background with real alpha. No black, gray, checkerboard or opaque background baked into image. No screenshots, weapon, character, UI, letters, logo, symbols or watermark.
Status material and palette: SOAKED: cool azure and deep blue flowing water streaks, chunky lens-like droplets, little ripples, wet refraction, turbulent running water
